verdict.rationale: Employees get a 'My Equity' view in the platform where they can see their available grants and exercise options through an 'Exercise Now' flow with document signing (docs-29, 38, 26). However, the evidence never shows that view displaying vesting progress or strike price. The scenario modeling features (docs-10, 33) are aimed at the company modeling rounds and investor returns, not employee-facing payout estimates. Missing for 10: evidence of employee-visible vesting progress, strike price display, employee-facing equity value/outcome modeling, independent corroboration.
